title.en: BA-CVA reduced with rho = 1 gives the sum of SCVA
title.es: BA-CVA reducido con rho = 1 da la suma de SCVA

invariant_cases.source: dossier 01 E.1 and M.1 (inputs constructed by the fixture)

statement.en: With rho = 1 the reduced capital base K_reduced equals the sum of the SCVA.
statement.es: Con rho = 1 la base K_reduced es igual a la suma de los SCVA.

title.en: Hedges never take K_full below beta K_reduced
title.es: Las coberturas nunca bajan K_full de beta K_reduced

invariant_cases.source: dossier 01 E.1 and M.1 (inputs constructed by the fixture)

statement.en: K_full = beta K_reduced + (1 - beta) K_hedged is at least beta K_reduced.
statement.es: K_full = beta K_reduced + (1 - beta) K_hedged es al menos beta K_reduced.

invariant_cases.source: dossier 01 D.2 and M.1 (input constructed by the fixture)

statement.en: The low scenario uses max(2 rho - 1, 0.75 rho) and the high scenario min(1.25 rho, 1); the SBM result is the maximum of the three.
statement.es: El escenario bajo usa max(2 rho - 1, 0.75 rho) y el alto min(1.25 rho, 1); el resultado SBM es el máximo de los tres.

title.en: SBM aggregation: within bucket, across buckets, maximum over the scenarios
title.es: Agregación SBM: dentro del bucket, entre buckets y máximo de los escenarios

invariant_cases.source: dossier 01 D.2 and M.1 (inputs constructed by the fixture)

statement.en: Two buckets with their within-bucket correlations and gamma 0.5: the bucket charge K_b of MAR21.4 under each of the three scenarios of MAR21.6, the cross-bucket charge and the maximum over the scenarios (MAR21.7).
statement.es: Dos buckets con sus correlaciones internas y gamma 0.5: el cargo K_b de MAR21.4 bajo cada escenario de MAR21.6, el cargo entre buckets y el máximo de los escenarios (MAR21.7).

invariant_cases.source: dossier 01 D.2 and M.1 (inputs constructed by the fixture)

statement.en: Two buckets of opposite sign and gamma 0.8: under the medium and high scenarios the radicand is negative and S_b is replaced by max(min(sum WS, K_b), -K_b) (MAR21.4(5)(b)); under the low scenario the plain path applies.
statement.es: Dos buckets de signo opuesto y gamma 0.8: bajo los escenarios medio y alto el radicando es negativo y S_b se reemplaza por max(min(sum WS, K_b), -K_b) (MAR21.4(5)(b)); bajo el bajo se aplica la vía simple.

title.en: Cascade with every LH equal to 10
title.es: Cascada con todos los LH iguales a 10

invariant_cases.source: dossier 01 D.3 and M.1 (input constructed by the fixture)

statement.en: If every risk factor has a liquidity horizon of 10 days the cascade returns ES_T(P); it is monotone in LH.
statement.es: Si todo factor tiene horizonte de liquidez de 10 días la cascada devuelve ES_T(P); es monótona en LH.

title.en: Cascade with a second liquidity horizon
title.es: Cascada con un segundo horizonte de liquidez

invariant_cases.source: dossier 01 D.3 and M.1 (inputs constructed by the fixture)

statement.en: ES = sqrt(ES_T(P)^2 + (ES_T(P, 2) sqrt((LH_2 - LH_1) / T))^2) = sqrt(100 + 36 x 1) = 11.661904; it is at least ES_T(P).
statement.es: ES = sqrt(ES_T(P)^2 + (ES_T(P, 2) sqrt((LH_2 - LH_1) / T))^2) = sqrt(100 + 36 x 1) = 11.661904; es al menos ES_T(P).

title.en: GIRR delta charge of a 10-year payer swap, with and without the sqrt(2) division
title.es: Cargo delta GIRR de un swap pagador a 10 años, con y sin la división por sqrt(2)

invariant_cases.paragraph_range: MAR21.19, MAR21.42 to MAR21.46 and MAR21.4 to MAR21.7
invariant_cases.source: dossier 01 D.2 and research addendum R7 (input constructed by the bake: a 10 million USD 10-year payer swap, s = 8.0e7 USD per unit of rate at the 10-year tenor)

statement.en: The headline charge divides the MAR21.42 risk weights by sqrt(2) for a specified currency such as USD (MAR21.44; a named parameter, label: convention, the bank's discretion); the charge of the undivided weights is written beside it and equals the headline times sqrt(2). With one non-zero tenor the charge is |RW s| under every scenario.
statement.es: El cargo principal divide los ponderadores de MAR21.42 por sqrt(2) para una moneda especificada como USD (MAR21.44; parámetro nombrado, etiqueta: convención, a discreción del banco); el cargo con los ponderadores sin dividir se escribe al lado y es el principal por sqrt(2). Con un solo plazo distinto de cero el cargo es |RW s| bajo todo escenario.
